name: Linked Release Notes
description: Generate release notes including changes from submodules

repository.description: Repository in owner/repo format (defaults to current repository)

tag.description: Tag to generate release notes for (defaults to current tag/ref)

previous_tag.description: Previous tag to compare against (auto-detected if not provided)

generated_submodule_link.description: prepends this string to the #PR links of the subodule notes. If unset, it will use the submodule owner/repo
